description: This Python source file defines an asynchronous chatbot implementation that integrates various external services such as speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model APIs, and custom functions for weather, restaurant, and image retrieval. It sets up a semantic pipeline for processing user interactions, managing function calls, and handling client connections with a focus on a conversational AI system.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema describing a function callable via the language model, including name, description, properties, and required arguments.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema aggregating tools available for the conversational system, such as weather, image, and restaurant tools.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline of the conversational AI, managing sequence of frames and processing steps.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a specific task with its pipeline, parameters, and optional timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Orchestrates the execution of pipeline tasks, handles signals, and manages startup/shutdown routines.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains conversation context and message history, includes methods for managing and updating context.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Holds paired context aggregators for user and assistant sides, managing conversation state.

classes.name: DeepgramSTTService
classes.description: Represents the speech-to-text transcription service used within the pipeline.

classes.name: CartesiaTTSService
classes.description: Text-to-speech service for converting text responses into audio.

classes.name: GoogleLLMService
classes.description: External LLM service enabling function registration and invocation.

methods.name: get_weather(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Fetches weather information for a specified location and sends it to the result callback.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Provides restaurant recommendation data to the result callback.

methods.name: get_image(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Initiates a process to capture user image feed and associates it with the ongoing context.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main function that initializes services, constructs the processing pipeline, and manages event handlers to run the bot.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Top-level async function to instantiate transport and start the bot, intended for integration with Pipecat Cloud.
